name: goal-loop
description: Check-backed /goal autonomous loops for Copilot CLI.

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Start an active check-backed goal loop.
commands.prompt: Start a Goal Loop with the objective: "$ARGUMENT". Write a contract to .cursor/goal/active.json and load the cursor-goal skill.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Draft a goal objective and check before activating.
commands.prompt: Draft a Goal Loop objective and check for: "$ARGUMENT".

commands.name: goal-status
commands.description: Read the active goal and last check result.
